title: Disabling Services via Registry
description: Search for processes modifying the registry to disable security features.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Command Line' like '*"reg"*' and 'Command Line' like '*add*' and 'Command Line' like '*"HKLM\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\*' and 'Command Line' like '*/v*' and 'Command Line' like '*/t*' and 'Command Line' like '*REG_DWORD*' and 'Command Line' like '*/d*' and 'Command Line' like '*/f*') and ('Command Line' like '*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*' or 'Command Line' like '*UseTPMKey*' or 'Command Line' like '*UseTPMKeyPIN*' or 'Command Line' like '*UseAdvancedStartup*' or 'Command Line' like '*EnableBDEWithNoTPM*' or 'Command Line' like '*RecoveryKeyMessageSource*'))
sentinel_source_path: Hunting Queries/Microsoft 365 Defender/Ransomware/DEV-0270/Disabling Services via Registry.yaml

ask_ai_prompts: Summarize the Microsoft Sentinel converted detection results and identify the highest-risk pivots.
